summary: Envirotech Vehicles, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its entry into an Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Azio AI Corporation. The transaction closed on July 2, 2026, and involves a merger with wholly owned subsidiaries. The filing indicates a proxy statement will be filed for stockholder approval of the conversion of Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock issued in the transaction into common stock, as required by Nasdaq rules. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or deal value are disclosed. Specific advisors are not named. The regulatory timeline depends on stockholder vote and Nasdaq approval. What to watch: the proxy statement for conversion terms and any potential shareholder dissent.
